subject.title: fix: strip volatile output from exec result hash to fix no-progress detection (#93917)

question: Should this PR's stable failed-exec fingerprint intentionally allow repeated failed exec retries to hit critical/global blocking despite changing output text?
rationale: The patch is a narrow bug fix, but it deliberately changes when agent execution is stopped for repeated failed exec calls, so maintainer intent is needed for the availability tradeoff.

options.title: Accept Stricter Failed-Exec Blocking
options.body: Merge after the docs follow-up and exact-head validation if maintainers agree stable failed exec retries should stop runaway sessions.

options.title: Defer For Broader Loop Policy
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the session-global or fuzzy loop-detection design to land before changing failed-exec hashing.

recommendation.title: Accept Stricter Failed-Exec Blocking
recommendation.body: Merge after the docs follow-up and exact-head validation if maintainers agree stable failed exec retries should stop runaway sessions.
